Chapter 7045: Gun’S Might

Chapter 7045: Gun’s Might

The massive machine’s legs resembled mountain ranges. After a resounding clang, enormous spikes ran down the legs and latched onto the spatial fabrics. The long machine resembled a weapon of sorts with an opening at the front, aiming at the empty space.

“What is this thing?” This shocked spectators even more.

It exuded a red light onto Immortal Bronze.

“I’m coming.” He immediately latched onto the new machine, channeling his primordial chaos true energy into it as ignition for the chamber.

Immortals felt a maelstrom being formed within the chamber, melting all affinities.

“Break!” Once they condensed into an ultimate power, Immortal Bronze fired.

A gray beam flickered before their eyes and something blasted forth - a bullet wielding the melted affinities.

“Boom!” Dusk Realm shook violently and immortals were horrified as the bullet struck the empty space.

The bullet contained enough power to pierce the tough bodies of a hundred immortals - a testament to its lethality.

If one could see the Dusk Realm from an outside perspective, they would see it being tossed around by the bullet's momentum.

“What is this thing?!” Someone screamed.

“This is ridiculous.” An immortal said with an ugly expression.

Bronze Immortal was dreadful enough but with the help of this weapon, he became strong enough to kill a primordial immortal with a few shots.

“Game’s over?” The crowd thought this was hopeless. Any reinforcement wouldn’t be enough to deal with the new weapon.

“Hahaha! The entrance will go down for sure!” Ash-serpent laughed.

“The dao court will be ours alone.” Immortal Bronze said with confidence.

This weapon was perfect for an ambush. It was just that in this case, it could also break the entrance to the dao court.

“Continue, Brother.” Ash-serpent said.

“Fellow Daoists, you must stop, lest you seek destruction.” Heaven’s Equal appeared, looming above all beings. This gave the crowd some hope.

“Heaven’s Equal.” Ash-serpent and Immortal Bronze didn’t share the same enthusiasm.

“Fellow Daoist, these attacks will bring an end to the inhabitants of Dusk Realm.” Heaven’s Equal said.

“Did you become a Bodhisattva of Compassion recently?” Ash-serpent laughed sarcastically.

“I just don’t wish to see you two die.” He said.

The crowd exchanged glances upon hearing this.

“You will kill us?” Immortal Bronze uttered coldly.

“Not me, but someone will certainly cut you down for continuing.” He shook his head.

“Li Qiye.” Listeners understood.

“As primordial immortals and unlike you, we fear no one.” Ash-serpent said.
